summary.text: Nina Milliken is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 16 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Milliken has represented District 16 since 2022 and lives in Blue Hill.

paragraphs.text: Nina Milliken lives in Blue Hill, Maine, and earned a B.A. from the University of California at Santa Cruz in 2010.
Milliken won District 16 in 2022, defeating Stephen Hanrahan, and won re-election in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Elections Committee and her 2023-2024 assignment as the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee.
Her 2026 general election opponent is Republican Eric White.
